title: VendPoint Schedule of Demand Evidence for Substitute Placements
content:
Schedule of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program setting what demand evidence sizes the par of a substitute Corbett places in a retired item's selection.

**Rule.** How much is known of the substitute's demand can replace the retired item's par in the standard par: when the retired item's units are above zero, its average per restock interval, those units divided by the weeks in that window and by the model's scheduled restock visits per week, divided by the model's low-stock trigger percentage taken as a fraction of one hundred, replaces it; when they are not but the retired item was ever vended on the machine, the larger of two figures, the retired item's par and the quotient of its largest single vend (the largest number of its units issued in one vend on the machine at any time) by the low-stock trigger fraction, replaces it; otherwise the retired item's par stands.

**Figures and terms.**

- The weeks in that window are 13, the weeks of the three months ending today.
- The retired item's units are its units vended from the machine in the three months ending today, less its units returned to the machine or credited for a vend error in the same three months, each record counted by its date.
- Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.
- The low-stock trigger fraction is the model's low-stock trigger percentage taken as a fraction of one hundred; the scheduled restock visits per week are the model's.
- The retired item's par is the par on its selection entry carrying the highest planogram request reference.

| Retired item's units, three months | Ever vended on the machine | Figure in place of the retired item's par |
|---|---|---|
| Above zero | yes | Units divided by 13, divided by the visits per week, divided by the trigger fraction |
| Zero or below | yes | The larger of the retired item's par and its largest single vend divided by the trigger fraction |
| Zero or below | no | The retired item's par |

### Hypothetical cases (1 visit a week, 25% trigger, retired item's par 10)

- Units 26: 26 divided by 13 is 2; divided by 1 is 2; divided by 0.25 is 8. The figure is 8.
- Units 0, largest single vend 3: 3 divided by 0.25 is 12; the larger of 10 and 12 is 12.
- Units 0, never vended: 10.
